description:
## What

The synthetic-message → LLM-user-message conversion (`OctoPi.Coder.Session.Messages.to_llm/1`) is a **wire-edge** transform: every place that hands messages to a provider must call it. Today it runs at:

- TUI's resume path — wires `messages_provider` that calls `to_llm/1` (`tui/interactive.ex:721-724`)
- `compaction/branch_summarization.ex:143` — calls `to_llm/1` before serializing for the summary LLM call

It does NOT run at:

- TUI's `new_session` path (`messages_provider` not wired — confirm and fix)
- `compaction/summary.ex` (the main compaction-summary LLM call) — input comes pre-built from `entry_to_messages/1` and is passed straight to `Summary.generate/4` without flattening synthetic types

## Why

This is asymmetric, not architecturally broken — synthetic types like `CompactionSummaryMessage` and `BranchSummaryMessage` happen to render fine for the summarization model today because `Serialize.conversation/1` and `Tokens.estimate_tokens/1` accept them. But the contract should be: synthetic types never reach a provider. The fix is consistency at every wire edge, not collapsing to one boundary (there are legitimately two: turn context and internal summarization prompts).

## Files

- `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/compaction/summary.ex` — apply `to_llm/1` to input messages before serializing the prompt
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` — wire `messages_provider` in `new_session/6` (currently only the resume path wires it)
- Optional: `apps/octo_pi_coder/lib/octo_pi/coder/session/messages.ex` — small docstring update if the contract becomes clearer

## Out of scope

- Adding new synthetic-message types (`bashExecution`, `custom`) — those land in their own port tickets.
- Refactoring `to_llm/1`'s internal structure.

## Independent of opi-1.1, opi-1.2, opi-1.3

Can land first, last, or in parallel — touches different code paths.

## Done when

- `compaction/summary.ex` calls `Messages.to_llm/1` on input before generating the prompt.
- `TUI.Interactive.new_session/6` wires `messages_provider` on the agent loop.
- A test confirms a `CompactionSummaryMessage` in `state.path` is converted to a wrapped user message at every wire edge (turn context + internal summarization).
- No synthetic-role struct ever reaches a provider in any code path.
title: Apply to_llm/1 consistently at all wire edges
